title: Anchor-derived collapse expander + wrap-panel button groups
body: AttachPanelViewModel exposes CollapseExpanderDock (Avalonia Dock) and CollapseGlyph derived from DockSide and raised on change. AttachPanelView docks a full-height collapse Button on CollapseExpanderDock and re-docks it on change. The tab buttons, Monitor buttons and Settings action buttons use WrapPanel with per-button margins.

acceptanceCriteria.text: CollapseExpanderDock is Dock.Right when DockSide is Left and Dock.Left when DockSide is Right
Changing DockSide raises PropertyChanged for CollapseExpanderDock and CollapseGlyph
